## What the code says

`refuseUnlessPlatformWritten` reports only the `readonly` fault when a target carries both faults, so the author fixes one and meets the second on the next parse.

## Wanted

- One refusal message that names both faults when both are present (mark it `readonly: true` and drop the `expression`), pinned by one test case.
